sentences.Hei! Vi vil gjerne ha et godt kart over: Hi! We'd like a good map of Oslo.
sentences.Takk. Har du en Oslo-guide?: Thanks. Do you have an Oslo guide?
sentences.Takk. Har dere kort og frimerker?: Thanks. Do you have postcards and stamps?
sentences.Ja, dere kan kjøpe kort og frimerker her: Yes, you can buy postcards and stamps here.
sentences.Har du en engelsk avis?: Do you have an English newspaper?
No. You'll have to go to a kiosk.
